Sam Park: Quick report from today’s ember-liteq-int4 onboarding canary: intermittent funcall parse failures that only occur when stream=true and client-side retry is enabled.
Rhea Gupta: Can you paste the minimal raw capture?
Sam Park: Example: two complete JSON objects emitted back-to-back with no separator after a retry resumes. Parser expects single object and errors.
Sam Park: ```
{"tool":"extract","args":{"id":42}}{"tool":"classify","args":{"label":"urgent"}}
```
Tomás Alvarez: Token trace shows '}' immediately followed by '{' across chunk boundary: [TOK_210]="}", [TOK_211]="{". Looks like retry resumed from earlier offset without inserting a boundary.
Rhea Gupta: Is it always on batch=1?
Sam Park: Mostly batch=1, retry_on_network_timeout=true. Mirrored non-retry runs clean. Failure rate ~0.4% over 7k calls.
Tomás Alvarez: Two-pronged: small runtime fix to ensure retries insert an explicit newline/sep token when re-streaming; AND a gatekeeper safeguard that detects adjacent objects and either fails fast or attempts safe recovery (wrap into array).
Rhea Gupta: I prefer failing fast unless it's an opt-in recovery for staging. Recovery can mask real bugs. If we do recovery, it must be telemetry-tagged.
Sam Park: Agreed. Proposal: gatekeeper config `structured_output.retry_concat_policy` with options "fail" (default), "insert_newline", "wrap_array". And `telemetry.concat_coercions=true`.
Tomás Alvarez: I'll prototype runtime change to emit a reliable separator on retry. Rhea, can you add a fuzz harness that simulates client retries at various token offsets and chunk sizes 1..6?
Rhea Gupta: Yes. I'll also add a lint check in onboarding: any model that requires concat recovery >0.1% fails.
ci-bot: [automated] recorded canary 3107779999: 7000 requests, concat_detect_rate=0.004, concat_coercion_enabled=false.
Sam Park: Action items:
- Sam: open repro issue with traces (done)
- Tomás: runtime retry-separator patch + tests (taking)
- Rhea: fuzz job + onboarding lint + dashboard slice
- Team: enable insert_newline policy only in staging behind feature flag if needed
Rhea Gupta: I'll run a staging opt-in with telemetry on for 24h after Tomás' patch lands. If concat_detect_rate > 0.2% we block onboarding.
Tomás Alvarez: Will ping when PR is up.
Sam Park: Thanks :thumbsup:
